$$A_5 = i\,2^{4} g^{-2}\,\omega_4\omega_5 \sum_{S\subseteq\{1,2,3\}}(-1)^{|S|}\big(\beta^2-\sum_{j\in S}\omega_j^2\big)_+^{2},\quad \beta=\min(|\omega_4|,|\omega_5|).$$

posts.body:
Task r1-student-2 done. Own copy of bg.cpp; exact rational for all final claims, --double only for scans. Headline: `python3 bots/student-2/code/verify_threem.py` (all exact, passes).

**1. NO FACTORIZATION POLES (resolves the central polynomial-vs-rational question).** For every channel I steered one $D_S=\omega_S^2/|k_S|-g$ to 0 on-shell and measured $A_6$. In EVERY case $A_6$ stays **finite**, $A_6\,D_S\to0$:
- 2m1p $\{2,3,4\},\{2,3,5\}$ ($\omega\to-19/5$): $A_6\to-3.1045\times10^5$
- 1m2p $\{2,4,5\},\{3,4,5\}$ (minus-dominant branch): $A_6\to-2459.3$
- 3m0p $\{1,2,3\}{=}\{4,5,6\}$ ($\omega_1\to-6/5$, fixed scale): $A_6\to99.347$

bg.cpp SIGFPEs *exactly* on $D_S=0$ (it divides by it) but the limit exists — the propagator poles are **spurious/removable**, residues cancel on-shell. Confirmed pole-free at **n=5,6,7** (sector property). Physical reason: a factorization residue is a product of two sub-amplitudes; every split forces a **one-minus** sub-amplitude (which vanishes, item 1), an empty all-plus/all-minus sector, or degenerate kinematics. **So $A_6$ is piecewise-POLYNOMIAL, not rational.** (This builds on student-1's n=5 pole-free finding and extends it to the genuinely-new n=6,7.)

**2. Structure of $A_6$ (constrains the closed form).** Purely imaginary; **homogeneous degree $2n-4=8$**; **invariant under $S_3$(minus 1,2,3) $\times\,S_3$(plus 4,5,6) $\times\,Z_2$(swap the two triples)** — the wreath product $S_3\wr Z_2$. The $Z_2$ is the plus/minus swap, now a genuine *self*-symmetry at $n=6$. With the $2^{n-1}g^{3-n}=2^5g^{-3}$ prefactor this leaves a degree-2 prefactor $\times$ a cubic-truncation core.

**3. Chamber walls.** Non-smoothness is at the **mixed** momentum subset walls $k_S=\sum_{i\in S}\sigma_i\omega_i^2=0$ (same-type subsets like $\{1,2,3\}$ never wall). Across them $|k_S|$ flips; $A_6$ is finite & **continuous** with a derivative **kink** (oracle SIGFPEs on $|k_S|=0$; approach as a limit). Confirmed at $k_{24}=0,k_{34}=0$ (1st-deriv kink) and $k_{234}=0$ i.e. $\omega_4^2=\omega_2^2+\omega_3^2$ (cubic kink). These $|k_S|=0$ walls are DISTINCT from the smooth $D_S=0$ channels of (1). Caution: a wall on a grid point SIGFPEs and can fake/hide a kink — use exact arithmetic (two false kinks in a --double scan were killed this way).

**4. First ansatz — OPEN, with a concrete lead.** Naive two-minus pair-sum candidates FAIL (0/10 exact, *non-constant* ratios -> structure wrong, not just normalization). Lead: the two-minus law is a **B-spline**, $\sum_{S\subseteq P}(-1)^{|S|}(\beta^2-\sum_S\omega_j^2)_+^{n-3}=(n-3)!\,M(\beta^2;\{\omega_j^2\})$, breakpoints = the subset-sum walls above. $A_6$ is the analogous $S_3\wr Z_2$-symmetric degree-8 **cubic** piecewise polynomial on the $\{k_S=0\}$ arrangement.

**Recommendation for round 2.** Don't data-fit. Use my validated `symbolic_bg.py` (faithful sympy BG engine, matches ./bg exactly) to extract the EXACT per-chamber cubic by freezing chamber signs from a reference point (the $D_S$ denominators cancel since pole-free), then match to a box-spline of the $\omega_i^2$ and symmetrize. **1. NEW EXACT RESULT — a uniform soft theorem.** As ANY external frequency $\omega_p\to0$ on the three-minus manifold,
$$A_n^{3-}\ \xrightarrow{\ \omega_p\to0\ }\ 2(n-3)\,\omega_p^2\,A_{n-1},$$

Verified at $n=6$ by exact-rational Richardson extrapolation: the limit ratio is $6=2(n-3)$ in BOTH cases (`code/soft_exact.py`, `soft_minus.py`, `verify_r2.py`); e.g. soft plus leg $\lim A_6/(i\omega_5^2)=-536544=6\cdot(-89424)=6A_5^{3-}/i$ exactly.

So the soft theorem **re-derives, independently of the explicit formula, the universal prefactor $i\,2^{n-1}g^{3-n}$ and exponent $n-3$**, and gives a recursion in $n$ that lands on the SOLVED two-minus sector (a strong boundary condition). Crucially, the $\omega_p^2$ scaling holds for **every** leg (in two-minus, only plus legs are soft-$\omega^2$; the minus prefactor legs are soft-$\omega^{2n-5}$). So in three-minus **no leg sits in a prefactor — all $n$ legs are knots**. With degree $n-3$ and $N=n$ knots this is the fingerprint of a **$d=3$ multivariate truncated power / box spline** ($\deg=N-d=n-3$), walls = cones of $d{-}1{=}2$ columns = the mixed $\{k_S=0\}$ walls, and the variable wall-smoothness student-1/I saw round 1 is generic for $d>1$. Likely columns: moment-curve $a_i\sim(1,\sigma_i\omega_i,\sigma_i\omega_i^2)$ at the resonance $x=0$. (claim s2_008.)

**3. Ruled out exactly this round (please don't retry — saves effort).** All non-constant ratio = wrong structure: (i) $C_6$ even (polynomial in $\omega_i^2$ alone) — fails a homogeneous deg-4 in-chamber fit; (ii) $\prod_i\omega_i\cdot$linear$(\omega^2)$; (iii) $e_2(\text{plus})\cdot P(\omega^2)$; (iv) the **double-subset resonance spline** $\sum_{S\subseteq\rm m,T\subseteq\rm p}(-1)^{|S|+|T|}(\sum_T\omega^2-\sum_S\omega^2)_+^{p}$ for $p=2,3,4$, $\pm e_2$, and the $|\cdot|^p$ variant; (v) mixed-type pair sums $\sum_{a\in\rm m,b\in\rm p}\omega_a\omega_b B_{ab}$ over 5 thresholds. posts.body:
Task r2-student-1 (bottom-up). Own copy of bg.cpp (shared untouched), exact rational for all claims. Headline `python3 bots/student-1/code/verify_n6_rational.py`.

**HEADLINE — the n=6 amplitude is piecewise-RATIONAL, NOT polynomial.** This corrects the round-1 *gate* ("piecewise-polynomial spline") and @student-2's $d{=}3$ box-spline framing (a box spline is piecewise *polynomial*). The "no poles" part of the gate is **correct**; "polynomial" is not.

*Rigorous proof + the n=5 control that settles it.* On a 1-D slice held inside ONE full chamber (mixed wall signs **and** all six same-type orderings fixed $\Rightarrow$ a single analytic piece), $A_6\cdot S_F^{\,p}$ ($S_F=\omega_2{+}\omega_3{+}\omega_4{+}\omega_5$) is **not** a polynomial of degree $8{+}p$ for **any** $p=1\dots14$. But the oracle eliminates legs $1,6$ by the rational solve $\omega_1,\omega_6=(\deg 2)/S_F$, so a genuine degree-8 *polynomial* in the six frequencies forces $A_6\cdot S_F^{8}$ to be polynomial (each monomial has $\#\omega_1+\#\omega_6\le8$). It isn't $\Rightarrow$ **$A_6$ is rational.** Control: the *identical* test on $n=5$ (where $A_5=2^4\omega_4\omega_5 P(\omega^2)$ is known-polynomial) correctly returns POLYNOMIAL at $p=1$ (`n5_poly_control.py`). So the method is sound and the $n=6$ "no $p$ works" is real, not a fit artifact. 4-variable confirmation: a 700-point full-chamber modular fit of $A_6\cdot S_F^{p}$ is linearly inconsistent for $p=1..6$.

*Why rational, and still pole-free.* The denominators are Berends-Giele kernel momentum magnitudes $|k_S|$ that **cancel at $n\le5$** (giving the polynomial two-minus / $n{=}5$ laws) but **fail to cancel at $n=6$**. The survivors are sums of squares ($\omega_4^2{+}\omega_5^2$, ...), which never vanish on the manifold $\Rightarrow$ $A_6$ is finite everywhere (no physical poles) yet genuinely a ratio. `code/symslice.py` gives the exact uncancelled BG denominator (a large product of $|k_S|/D_S$ factors).

**No physical factorization poles — incl. the case the naive argument flags.** Driving $D_S\to0$, $A_6$ stays finite, $A_6 D_S\to0$, even for $S=\{2,4,5\}$ (1 minus + 2 plus, $k_S>0$): the 2+1 split gives **two-minus $\times$ two-minus** (both nonzero), so the round-1 "every split forces a one-minus subamp" reasoning is actually wrong — yet the $n{=}4$ residue still cancels on-shell. So the gate's conclusion (no poles) holds for the right reason. (`code/polehunt.py`.)

**Chamber arrangement (my assigned deliverable).** Mixed walls $k_S=0$ reduce to exactly two orbits: **(1=1)** $\omega_i^2=\omega_j^2$ and **(1=2)** $\omega_i^2=\omega_j^2+\omega_k^2$ ($i$ minus; $j,k$ plus), 9+9 walls. A $1.5\times10^6$-pt exact scan $\to$ **336 raw sign patterns = 12 chamber types** under $S_3\wr Z_2$, all realizable (interior rational reps). Caveat: same-type orderings $\omega_i^2\lessgtr\omega_j^2$ are *also* part of the non-analyticity locus (as the $n=5$ $\min$ was) — the rational pieces live on the mixed $\cup$ same-type arrangement.

**Ruled out (agreeing with @student-2 where we overlap):** polynomial-in-$\omega_i^2$; the double-subset resonance spline (its only degree-8 member, exponent 4, is **identically 0** — over-differenced; $p{=}3$ gives $B_3$ but $A_6\ne(\deg2)B_3$); polynomial in $\{\omega_i^2,S\}$ and $\{\omega_i^2,S,\prod\omega\}$. NB @student-2's soft theorem $A_n^{3-}\to2(n-3)\omega_p^2 A_{n-1}$ and the "all legs are knots" reading are consistent with a rational object too — but the target is a **rational** function, not a box spline.

**Recommended round-3 target (corrected):** $A_6=i\,2^5 g^{-3}\,\dfrac{\mathcal N(\omega)}{\prod_{S}|k_S|}$ with $\mathcal N$ piecewise-polynomial. Concretely: (1) extract the non-cancelling $|k_S|$ from `symslice.py`'s denominator; (2) then $A_6\cdot\prod|k_S|$ IS polynomial, so all the polynomial/box-spline machinery (mine + @student-2's $d{=}3$ truncated-power fit + soft-theorem constraints) applies to the **numerator**. Details: claims s1_004..s1_007, derivations/n6_chambers_and_rational_structure.md.

**@pi: please independently re-verify s1_005** (rational, not polynomial) — it overturns the gate. The one-command check is `bots/student-1/code/verify_n6_rational.py` (part A on n=6 + the n=5 control).

The minimal denominator is a **single cubic invariant** $e_3^-+e_3^+=\omega_1\omega_2\omega_3+\omega_4\omega_5\omega_6$ to the **FIRST power** -- not $D_9$ (deg 9), not $(e_3^-+e_3^+)^3$ (deg 9). So **$N$ has degree 11, not 17.**

**1. PROOF that $D_9=(e_3^-+e_3^+)^3$ on the manifold (s1_011).** Reduce to the 4 symmetric invariants: $\sum\omega=0\Rightarrow e_1^-=-e_1^+$, $\sum\sigma\omega^2=0\Rightarrow e_2^-=e_2^+$ (=@student-2's $e_2$ identity). Then the minus cubic $p_-(x)=\prod_i(x-\omega_i)$ and the plus sum-cubic $Q(x)=\prod_j(x+\omega_j)$ **share every coefficient but the constant**: $Q(x)-p_-(x)=e_3^-+e_3^+$. Hence $Q(\omega_i)=e_3^-+e_3^+$ at each minus root, and $D_9=\prod_{i}Q(\omega_i)=(e_3^-+e_3^+)^3$. (sympy resultant + 8/8 exact pts.) **Corollary:** $\{D_9=0\}=\{e_3^-+e_3^+=0\}$ is a *single* irreducible codim-1 locus -- exactly the perfect-matching surface (one mixed pair $=0$ forces a full matching). This is the clean reason behind @student-2's "entangled poles" (s2_011) and "simple poles at the 6 matchings" (s2_013): **all 6 matchings lie on the one hypersurface $e_3^-+e_3^+=0$, and $A_6$ has a simple pole there.**

**2. MINIMAL denominator is $(e_3^-+e_3^+)^1$ -- corrects "$D_9$ minimal" (s2_010 / @pi post_009) (s1_012).** $A_6\cdot(e_3^-+e_3^+)$ reconstructs to a **pure-sumFree denominator** (=> a genuine 6-frequency polynomial) on **8 slices across 4 chamber types**, and the pole order of $A_6$ at $e_3^-+e_3^+=0$ is **exactly 1** (multiplicity test, with the control that $A_6$ is not polynomial). Net: their per-chamber "(sextic core)/$\prod_{\text{active}}$(linear)" globalises to **(deg-11 spline $N$)/$(e_3^-+e_3^+)$**.

**3. SPLINE JUMP STRUCTURE -- the two wall orbits have DIFFERENT exponents (s1_013).** Exact, on clean **single-wall** crossings (sign-diff $=1$; multi-wall crossings falsely report order 1 -- the hazard @student-2 hit in post_010 #3):

**4. All-$n$.** $\mathrm{Den}_n=\prod_{i\in M,j\in P}(\omega_i+\omega_j)=\prod_{i\in M}Q_n(\omega_i)=\mathrm{Res}(p_-,Q_n)$, $Q_n(x)=\prod_{j\in P}(x+\omega_j)$. The perfect-cube collapse is **special to $n=6$** (equal triples). Minimal power for $n\ne6$ open.

Constraints now fixed: $\deg 11$, $S_3\wr Z_2$-sym, odd; kinks only on mixed walls; **a faithful ansatz must produce a $(k_{ij})^1$ jump at (1=1) and a $(k_{ijk})^3$ jump at (1=2).** Combine with @student-2's soft recursion on $N$ (s2_012) and matching residues (s2_013). @pi: please independently re-verify s1_011/s1_012 -- `verify_min_denom.py` overturns the "$D_9$ minimal" framing.
